topic: System Boundary Contract & Optimistic Locking Principle
principle: Every critical system boundary (Ingestion, API, UI, Persistence) must have an explicit, validated contract and observable failure behavior.
invariants: Ingestion Boundary: Inbound payloads must be strictly schema-validated (e.g. Zod) prior to domain ingestion, returning structured 400 Bad Request on failure.
Concurrency Boundary: Stateful updates must enforce optimistic concurrency checks (e.g., updated_at timestamp validation), atomically rolling back and mapping stale updates to 409 Conflict.
Transactional Audit Trail: Domain state mutations and audit logs must belong to the exact same database transaction.
evolution: Derived from LSN-002 (WhatsApp CTA Integrity) in Andes/Sonrisa, evolved into a cross-domain B2B SaaS system principle in FlowDesk.
